headline: Nigeria's CMFC Signs $50 Million Deal for Tanzania Gold Mine
summary: Critical Minerals Financing Corp. Plc, a minerals-focused investment firm listed in Nigeria, signed a $50 million transaction to finance and develop a gold asset in Tanzania.
why: Pan-African mining finance deals indicate growing cross-border capital deployment between West African capital markets and East African natural resource projects.

impacts.name: Tanzanian Gold Mining
impacts.why: $50 million commitment delivers fresh project financing to advance gold extraction in Tanzania.
